discovery: Experimental discovery of the Higgs boson by the ATLAS and CMS experiments at the LHC
motivation: The 2012 observation of the Higgs boson by ATLAS and CMS confirmed the mechanism honoured in 2013, but the experimental achievement itself has never been recognised. It required conceiving, designing and building detectors of unprecedented complexity, controlling systematics at a level many thought impossible at a hadron collider, and combining diphoton and four-lepton channels into an unambiguous discovery. Peter Jenni (founding ATLAS spokesperson) and Michel Della Negra (founding CMS spokesperson) shaped these experiments from proto-collaboration through construction; Fabiola Gianotti led ATLAS through the discovery. Since then, the measured couplings, spin-parity and mass have turned the Higgs into a precision laboratory, now probing the self-coupling and the shape of the Higgs potential, which governs the electroweak phase transition of the early universe. This is a definite, foundational discovery about nature's structure, achieved through leadership of collaborations without parallel.
